alt.en: A teal glass agent cube at the front, beside a signed mandate page with a brown header and a cinnabar seal, sends a dashed orange line with packets through the opening of an indigo gateway to a gray database behind it. A dotted indigo line runs from the gateway to a row of ledger blocks at the right.
alt.zh: 前方一个青色玻璃智能体方块，旁边立着一页带朱砂印章的签名任务授权声明；一条带数据包的橙色虚线从智能体穿过靛蓝色门框的开口，到达后方的灰色数据库；一条靛蓝色点线从门框连到右侧的一排账本方块。

caption.en: Illustration: an agent carrying a signed mandate passes a policy gate before it reaches data, and the gate's decisions are written to an append-only log, as in the design direction NIST proposes. It does not depict a tested deployment, NIST's demonstrations or any real agent system, and it does not show that the tenets work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：智能体持签名任务授权声明，先经过策略执行关口再访问数据，关口的决定记入仅可追加的日志，对应 NIST 提出的设计方向。图中不描绘经过测试的部署、NIST 的演示或任何真实智能体系统，也不表明这些原则按所述方式有效。
